title: Widgets editor drawer
description: Detailed configuration drawer for the selected widget.

ui.overview: The Widgets editor drawer changes the configuration of the selected widget. It does not move the widget itself; it edits how the widget looks and behaves in the scene or export board.

controls.label: Position controls
controls.description: Changes where the widget sits in the scene or on the board.

controls.label: Size controls
controls.description: Changes the widget scale and the space it occupies.

controls.label: Rotation controls
controls.description: Changes the orientation of widgets that support rotation.

controls.label: Style and visibility options
controls.description: Adjusts the visual treatment and shows or hides widget-specific options.

controls.label: Preview
controls.description: Shows a preview of the widget and its changes in the composition.

controls.label: Widgets
controls.description: Shows the widget list so you can switch widgets or access their order.

controls.label: Typography and text
controls.description: Depending on the widget, controls typeface, size, line height, color, stroke, and text content.

controls.label: Background, border, shadow, radius
controls.description: Depending on the widget, controls its background, border, shadow, and corner radius.

controls.label: Padding and alignment
controls.description: Controls internal spacing and content alignment.

controls.label: Visibility switch
controls.description: Shows or hides the widget without deleting its configuration.

steps.title: Open the preview
steps.description: Stay on the Preview tab to see how changes affect the selected widget.

steps.title: Tune the properties
steps.description: Edit the fields exposed by the widget, including position, size, rotation, typography, colors, and effects.

steps.title: Switch widgets
steps.description: Open the Widgets tab to choose another widget or return to its composition order.

steps.title: Check visibility
steps.description: Use the visibility switch to test a composition without losing the widget settings.

notes: This drawer is the configuration surface for a selected widget.
Use it after selecting the widget you want to tune in the scene.
